name: Spider-Slayer (J. Jonah Jameson)

abilityDetails.Instant Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Obfuscate: Saldırı yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen miktarda azaltır.
abilityDetails.Austere Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Falter: Rakibin bir sonraki saldırısının ıskalamasına sebep olur.
abilityDetails.Power Burn: Hedeften belirli miktarda güç alır, ardından alınan güçle orantılı doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Cowardice: Özel saldırı hasarını belirtilen güçte azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Kiti basit — bloğuna vurma, vurursan vacilo (hata) uygular. Görünmezliğe karşı direnç/önleyici yetenekler en iyi cevap.
signatureAbility:
Cowards Hide Behind Masks
A completed Headline inflicts a [10 - 20]% Cowardice Passive for 12 seconds and refreshes existing ones. These are paused during Special Attacks. Max stacks: 3.
Once per fight when J. Jonah takes a picture of the Opponent, he gains an indefinite +[85 - 485.28] Austere Armor Up Buff. This Armor Up persists between fights if J. Jonah defeats the menace with at least one of these Armor Ups active. Max stacks: 8.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: The Spider-Slayer's robotics have thorough protection for J. Jonah's physical body, providing Immunity to Bleed and Poison.

J. Jonah isn't trained to land Critical Hits. When he would land a Critical Hit, the Spider-Slayer suit instead inflicts Instant Shocks dealing Energy Damage equal to the Critical Damage the hit would have dealt.
As a Defender, J. Jonah's Shocks and Power Burns have 70% reduced potency.
All of J. Jonah's personal effects, as well as the Parry and Dexterity Masteries, gain 25% increased Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: Anger Management
content: J. Jonah Jameson has a short fuse and doesn't like being manipulated. When he is inflicted with Taunt, Infuriate, Intimidate, or Delirium, he becomes more aggressive and filled with a +[3,950]% Fury Passive for 12 seconds. Max stacks: 10.
J. Jonah's personal Furies cannot end during his Special Attacks.
Similarly, J. Jonah is a natural at riling up his detractors. When the Opponent hits J. Jonah's Block, he inflicts them with a 50% Obfuscate Debuff for 5 seconds. Max stacks: 2.

abilitySections.title: Spider-Slayer Armor
content: Start each fight with an indefinite +[485.29] Austere Armor Up Buff.
Armor Ups gained after the first have a potency of +[70.51] and duration of 20 seconds, expiring one at a time.
J. Jonah's Shocks and Power Burns gain 15% increased potency for each active Armor Up effect, up to 20 Armor Ups.

abilitySections.title: Front Page Headline
content: J. Jonah Jameson has the best Front Page Headlines in the business. After a fight begins, J. Jonah will improvise a Headline for how he will fight the latest menace and call out an action for the Attacker to complete.
Front Page Headlines have 7 seconds to be completed, with a 5 second cooldown. As a Defender, these timers are swapped.
If the Attacker completes a Headline:
J. Jonah gains a Spider-Slayer Austere Armor Up Buff.
Inflict a Slow Passive for 12 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. While a #Spider-Verse Hero is suffering from a Slow effect, J. Jonah can't Miss.
When a Headline fails, J. Jonah loses 1 personal Armor Up.
No new Headlines are created during any Special Attacks. As an Attacker, Headlines are paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attack - Headline Rewrite
content: As an Attacker, landing the final hit of a Heavy Attack during a Front Page Headline refreshes the Headline with a new choice.

abilitySections.title: Smile for the Camera!
content: As an Attacker holding block, J. Jonah can Swipe Up on his controls to take a picture of the Opponent, causing a blinding flash and Passively Faltering the Opponent for 3 seconds.
As a Defender, the camera is used automatically once J. Jonah starts to Block an attack. Auto-Block won't trigger this.
This effect goes on cooldown once used, and becomes available again after 2 Front Page Headlines have started.
When the Opponent Misses while Faltered, J. Jonah gains a personal Fury Passive. This can only trigger once per Falter.
J. Jonah and the Opponent have increased aggression while J. Jonah's Opponent is Faltered. While J. Jonah's personal Falter is active, he gains Stun Immunity.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: While the Opponent is below Max Power, each Special Attack hit Power Burns them, up to a combined total of 10%, 20%, or 30% of their Max Power based on the Special Attack used.
These Power Burns deal up to [1,866.382] Direct Damage for every 1% of Max Power burnt.

abilitySections.title: Possible Headlines
content: The Headlines J. Jonah requests can change depending on conditions in the fight, such as the existence of certain effects on a Champion, Power level, or who he is fighting against. Possible Headline actions:
I require pictures (of Spider-Man)!
Hit a Light Attack
Hit a Medium Attack
Charge a Heavy Attack
Block an attack
Inflict a Stun
Use Dexterity to Dodge an attack

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Cowards Hide Behind Masks
content: A completed Headline inflicts a [10 - 20]% Cowardice Passive for 12 seconds and refreshes existing ones. These are paused during Special Attacks. Max stacks: 3.

Once per fight when J. Jonah takes a picture of the Opponent, he gains an indefinite +[85 - 485.28] Austere Armor Up Buff. This Armor Up persists between fights if J. Jonah defeats the menace with at least one of these Armor Ups active. Max stacks: 8.
